assets.name: floor
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One Shift game environment, 1536x1024 landscape.
REFERENCE ROLE: the attached approved truck print governs the visual medium, ink coverage, quiet texture and exact charcoal, subdued rust and warm cream palette. It does not govern composition. Make a new architectural scene. Flat printed shapes and confident spare edges, only modest local ink grain, as simple and clear as the truck reference. No photographic lighting, gradients, glossy render, all-over grunge, crosshatch sketching or ornamental detail.
SCENE: a genuinely buildable compact distribution warehouse. Camera is a person standing 1.6 metres above the floor just inside the staff entrance at the front-left corner, looking DIAGONALLY across a clear cross-aisle toward the loading wall. Asymmetrical two-point perspective, a horizontal human eye line, NOT a bird's-eye view. The building is one continuous room, not three portals or a theatrical hallway.
LEFT THIRD: a small raised foreman's office at modest mezzanine height about 2.4 metres, cream panels in dark steel frame, wired-glass windows and a single office door. A real steel staircase runs from the clear floor up to its little landing, with visible treads, continuous handrails and physical steel supports. Short protective bollards guard support posts at floor level. Make stair and landing form one plainly recognizable clickable destination.
FAR WALL CENTER: exactly TWO adjacent loading docks, ordinary roll-up openings with thick dark bumpers and control boxes. Left receiving dock is open onto an EMPTY dark trailer with simple perspective rails; right shipping dock has a closed corrugated door. Both docks share one same straight wall plane, and directly in front are clear floor staging lanes defined by worn simple stripe edges. Do not draw cargo in either dock or staging lane.
RIGHT THIRD: an open entrance to the inventory aisles, empty durable charcoal steel racks with restrained rust horizontal beams running back at right angles from the clear cross-aisle. Their repeated geometry belongs to this same room, not a third doorway. At least one end upright and the clear route between racks readable.
NEAR LEFT EDGE: small ordinary time recorder at reachable height mounted on the entrance column, with a narrow row of card pockets beside it. This fifth destination is modest in size and separated from the office stairs.
Foreground open working concrete, a few construction seams, rubbed lane markings, slight tyre scuffs; continuous visible routes connect all destinations. Ceiling trusses, practical conduit and lights, modest believable wear at corners. Maintained, durable, used.
No people, forklifts, pallets, boxes, decorative stock, letters, numerals, text, signs, logos, UI or labels. No dramatic cavern, no abandoned ruin, no pristine showroom. Do not align destinations in a symmetric row. All five destinations fully within frame. Target the restrained print quality of the supplied reference above all.
assets.intent: One coherent room, raised office and stair at left, adjacent docks on far wall, rack aisles right, small time recorder near entrance.

assets.name: clock
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One Shift interactive time-card station background, landscape 1536x1024.
Image 1 is the approved visual STYLE reference: match its broad flat ink forms, charcoal black, muted rust, warm cream and restrained local dry grain. Image 2 is the ARCHITECTURE reference for the same warehouse. Create a new close standing-eye-level view facing the small time recorder on the near left staff-entry wall in image 2. Do not depict the large room again.
An ordinary practical electromechanical time recorder in a worn dark steel case, physically about 30cm wide and 40cm tall, mounted chest-high on the cream-over-rust painted block wall. Seen from about one metre away, nearly front-on with a little right side visible. The device is a squat rectangular box with a gently sloped cream upper face and a credible narrow horizontal paper-card insertion slot at the TOP; below is a small dark rectangular display window, a small keyhole and simple mechanical fasteners. Absolutely no giant circular wall-clock dial. Immediately beside it to the right, one narrow steel wall rack of vertically staggered blank cream punch cards in individual pockets, reachable and slightly worn. Show the complete device and full card rack comfortably within frame. One blank card rises just above the insertion mouth without obscuring the slot; it can act as the interaction target.
At far right a narrow glimpse beyond the dark entrance column into the SAME warehouse as image2: the lower steel stair and its rust handrail, the base bollard and clear concrete walkway. This is an exit destination that reads as returning to the floor. Keep the recorder, the card pockets and the passage clearly separate. No new doorway invented behind the device.
Composition: recorder approximately x28-51%, y28-70%; card rack x56-70%, y20-77%; right passage x79-100%,y8-100%; unobtrusive cream wall on left. Human height and everyday tool scale. Device has polished edges from use, modest chipped corner paint, a short conduit, screw heads. Durable equipment still used each day, not a rusty ruin.
No readable letters, numerals, brand marks, signs, UI, decorative labels, people, hands, pallets or freight. Quiet flat print with sparse matter-of-fact detail. Do not add photorealistic textures, gradients, dramatic directional light, shadow noise or dense ornamental grunge.
assets.intent: Close view of the actual small staff-entry recorder and narrow card pockets with the same stairs visible.

assets.name: office
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One Shift interactive office environment, landscape 1536x1024.
Image1 is the approved truck STYLE reference. Match its limited charcoal-black, muted rust and warm cream ink palette, broad flat quiet forms, a few descriptive edges and modest dry-print texture. Image2 is the ARCHITECTURE reference, showing the small raised foreman's office on the LEFT above a short steel stair. Create the INSIDE of that same office from a person SEATED behind its only desk, looking naturally across the desktop.
One practical old steel pedestal desk occupies lower 45% of image, durable dark charcoal laminate top with subtle rubbed front edge. Four separate, entire objects sit on its surface, generously spaced and ALL fully inside the image with visible margin: a cream purchase-order clipboard and single black pen at front left; a steel-wire customer-paper in-tray with a few blank cream sheets at rear left; a thick muted rust accounting ledger with dark cloth spine at middle-right; a smaller pale cream equipment catalog at front right. These must be visibly different shapes with clear outlines and no mutual overlap. No writing on their covers or sheets. Keep papers modest normal desk size, not enormous slabs filling the frame. Exactly ONE desk, not a cluster of office furniture or extra desk extension.
The office has cream industrial panel walls in dark steel framing like image2. Broad wired-glass window LEFT/back overlooks the warehouse at the modest elevated height of this office: a hint of upper rack beams, same roof trusses and a portion of concrete aisle below. This is still seated eye-level interior perspective, not top down. Back-right a partly open rust-painted office door leads to the real small steel landing and a visible guardrail beyond, then the warehouse. Door exit and landing must be credible at the SAME elevated height. Do not put a ground-floor warehouse doorway behind the desk. One short filing cabinet at rear wall is okay, a mug at distant desk edge is okay, keep visual clutter low.
Composition: PO clipboard x9-33%, y65-86%; in-tray x25-46%,y49-63%; ledger x53-72%,y59-78%; catalog x75-93%,y72-89%; exit doorway x75-94%,y13-54%. Actual blank wall/desktop between targets. Full clipboard and catalog must NOT cross frame edges. A little desk edge at bottom, natural space above. No people or hands.
Everyday maintained wear only: repaired panel corner, rubbed chair-height trim, scuffed door push plate. No generalized grime, pristine luxury, photo-real lighting, gradients, tonal airbrushing or dense etching. No stock, decorative freight, letters, numerals, logos, signs, UI or labels. Same flat, strong print language as the supplied truck.
assets.finalEditPrompt:

Remove every cardboard carton, box or merchandise shape visible THROUGH the left/background wired-glass windows and through the open door. All warehouse rack shelves outside must be visibly EMPTY; preserve the real steel uprights, beams, bracing, wire glass, doors, trusses and all architecture.
Keep the complete office interior, every pixel position of the desk, clipboard and pen, in-tray, ledger, equipment catalog, filing cabinet, door, landing, handrail, camera, image dimensions, palette, material style and broad flat ink treatment unchanged. Do not redraw or move any foreground object or alter their silhouettes. No new objects or text. No cargo anywhere outside the office. This is a precise removal edit, not a reinterpretation.
assets.intent: Seated behind one desk inside the raised office; four separate objects and landing outside the door.
